notes.content:

Hey everyone, 

Festival Tycoon solo dev Johannes has just posted a dev update including: 

 looking for playtesters
 teasing new gameplay mechanics
 new stage setups for Rock bands! 
 UI updates and hipster clippy! 
 a bug that allows you to kick your friends through a festival (please don't do this!) 

The full update can be found here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1326270/announcements/detail/2972924719012357460

notes.title: Omno September Kickstarter Update
notes.content:
Hey Omno Prologue Fans, here's a short version of my latest Kickster update :)  

You can read more on the main Omno page, or via Kickstarter (links below)

What have I been working on this month?

Puzzles, making things pretty, and lots of work on the game’s main collectable - the “explorer stones”. I’ve been experimenting with different ideas to make the system feel really rewarding - I’m toying with the idea of collecting a certain number of stones triggering a short speed increase that feels rewarding or something fun like that, but obviously making sure it doesn’t break any of the other game’s systems is very important too, so I’m still working on that :D

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33862400/d7ba3d5777222fcbe883d9ca5d333f043d1d656f.jpg

Don't forget, if you haven't already, you can wishlist the full game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/969760/Omno/

Big love as always, and as ever let me know in the comments if you have any questions.

[You can read the full, more detailed Kickstarter update here]
